column2: Today's study - an open hardcover book lying slightly angled, its pages fanned, a classic fountain pen resting across the pages with a tiny ochre nib, two loose index cards tucked under the book, and a small sprig of fern and olive leaves rising from behind the book. Viewed from a gentle three-quarter angle from above.

Flashcard review - a loose fan of three stacked paper flash cards seen from slightly above; the top card is turning over at one corner and shows only one large engraved serif capital letter A (a single letter, nothing else written); a sage ribbon bookmark curls out from under the cards and a small eucalyptus sprig lies beside them.

Meaning match - an antique magnifying glass with an ochre brass rim and a sage handle, lying over three interlocking letterpress type blocks shaped like jigsaw-puzzle pieces; each block carries one raised serif letter (single letters only, e.g. W, O, R); one small olive sprig beside them.

Listen and spell - a pair of vintage over-ear headphones with sage ear cushions and small ochre fittings, resting beside three wooden letterpress letter blocks (single serif letters only); from one ear cup, three or four fine engraved sound-wave lines flow outwards like etched ribbons; a small fern frond curls at the base.

Today's study is complete - a closed hardcover book with a sage cloth cover and an ochre ribbon bookmark hanging out, a cup of tea on a saucer resting on top of the book with three thin engraved steam curls, and a small potted sprig of olive leaves in a simple ochre clay pot beside it. Restful, finished, calm.

Quiet, independent study, offline - deliberately SIMPLE and bold so it still reads when shown small (about 80 px): a small vintage oil lamp with a flat ochre flame (no glow), standing beside one closed notebook with a pencil on top and a single small leaf. Fewer, slightly thicker engraved lines than usual.

An empty word library, waiting to be filled - one short wooden bookshelf section seen straight on, mostly empty, with just two slim books leaning against each other at one end, an open blank notebook with ruled lines lying on the shelf, and a small trailing ivy plant in a little pot spilling over the top edge. Hopeful, not sad.

Learning that grows over time - three stacks of books arranged left to right with increasing height like a gentle bar chart (two, four and six books), and a young sapling with fresh leaves growing out of the tallest stack, the leaves getting larger towards the top; a few fallen leaves at the base.

Brand key visual for "Wordkeep", a vocabulary app - a large open antique book standing on its spine, from whose pages a botanical stem grows upwards like a herbarium specimen; instead of some of its leaves, a few single engraved serif letters (A, W, K, e - single glyphs only, never words) hang on the stem like leaves; an ochre circular disc behind the plant like a low sun; one or two fern fronds at the base. Iconic, balanced, memorable.
